# Schedules

Scheduled webhooks per instance, called in-process even while the instance sleeps, with a catch-up run after downtime.

**Runs on:** [pocker](/docs/plugins/pocker) (multitenant).

> **Planned.** Nothing is published here yet. This folder will hold the plugin's Go module
> (`github.com/pockethost/pocketone/ext/schedules`), its tests and a minimal `example/main.go` that builds and shows the
> feature. See [Create your own plugin](/docs/writing-a-plugin).
